senses.gloss:
ली I. €1 P. (लयति) To melt, dissolve. ━II. €9 P. (लिनाति)
—1 To adhere.
—2 To melt, usually with वि. ━III. €4 Ā. (लीयते, लीन)
—1 To stick or adhere firmly to, cling to.
—2 To clasp, embrace.
—3 To lie or rest on, recline, stay or dwell in, lurk, hide, cower down;
 (भृङ्गाङ्गनाः) लीयन्ते मुकुलान्तरेषु शनकैः संजातलज्जा इव Ratn. 1. 26;
 हरिशिशुरुत्पतितुं द्रागङ्गान्याकुञ्च्य लीयते निमृतम् Bv. 1. 106;
 R. 3. 9; Ś. 6. 16; Ku. 1. 12, 7. 21; Bk. 18. 13; Ki. 5. 26.
—4 To be dissolved, melt away.
—5 To be sticky or viscous.
—6 To be absorbed in, be devoted or attached to; माधव मनसिजविशिखभयादिव
 भावनया त्वयि लीना Gīt. 4.
—7 To vanish, disappear. ━Caus. (लापयति-ते, लाययति-ते, लीनयति-ते,
 लालयति-ते) To melt, dissolve, liquefy. (The form लापयते is used
 in the sense of ‘to honour’, ‘cause to be honoured’; जटाभिर्लापयते
 = पूजामधिगच्छति; cf. P. I. 3. 70.).
